name: Y'all Means All Sugar Scrub
blurb: Rainbow layers of sweet exfoliant that slough off the rough, leave skin soft, and look like a Pride parade in a jar. Glitter-and-grit self-care that means exactly what it says: everybody's welcome.

usageGuide.howToApply: Buff gently onto wet skin in circular motions during shower or bath. Rinse thoroughly with warm water to reveal silky soft, exfoliated skin.
usageGuide.storage: Keep jar sealed tightly and avoid introducing standing water into jar. Shelf life is 6–12 months.
usageGuide.patchTest: Test a small dab on inner wrist before first use. Discontinue if redness occurs.
